p1.title: ONE-TIME INVESTMENT
p1.desc: Make a one-time contribution through a structured investment approach designed for investors who prefer lump-sum investing.
p1.overview: Make a structured lump-sum contribution across diverse economic growth sectors managed with expert financial guidance.
features: Structured one-time investment starting from ₹25,000.
Allocated across multiple sectors including Real Estate, Mutual Funds (SIP), Share Market, FMCG, and Govt Tenders.
Expert Guidance: Company operates as a financial planner with specialized sectoral management.
Gold Coin Incentive: Free 2-gram pure gold coin for lump-sum investments of ₹5,00,000 (₹5 Lakhs) or above.
Withdrawal Freedom: Flexible withdrawal options subject to company guidelines.
Payment Protection: Verification advice for direct payments via official company bank accounts or official UPI (Paytm/PhonePe).
p1.disclaimer: Illustrative figure shown in the plan brochure. Please refer to applicable plan terms for complete details.

p2.title: DAILY INVESTMENT PLAN
p2.desc: Build a disciplined investment habit with small daily contributions.
p2.overview: A disciplined savings model enabling regular daily contributions across diversified business sectors.
features: Micro daily contributions starting from ₹10 per day.
Direct Referral Gift: 5% reward on each direct new entry.
Instant Payment SMS: Mobile SMS confirmation issued within 24 hours of instalment payment.
Diversified Allocation: Mutual Funds (SIP), Govt Tenders, Real Estate, FMCG, Foreign Currency, Retail & Travel.
Helpline Assistance: Customer complaint portal helpline (+91 6393552408) for transaction verifications.
p2.disclaimer: Example shown in the plan brochure. Instalments must be paid regularly for the full 12-month period. Please refer to applicable plan terms for complete details.

p3.title: DAILY RETURN PLAN
p3.desc: A structured investment option designed around daily returns.
p3.overview: Capital investment options offering daily return payouts, with separate promotional tiers for distinct investment levels.
features: Structured lump-sum options starting from ₹1,00,000.
Daily Return Payouts according to the selected brochure tier.
Referral Return: Earn ₹25/day extra return per active reference on Option 1.
Gold Incentive: Free 1-gram pure gold coin on investments of ₹5,00,000 (₹5 Lakhs) or above.
Transparent Tracking: Distinct promotional offers formatted cleanly per brochure guidelines.

p4.title: FLEXI SAVING PLAN
p4.desc: A flexible saving option designed for smaller and regular contributions.
p4.overview: A flexible daily saving scheme designed for low and middle-income investors with a short 7-month contribution window.
features: Accessible daily investment starting at ₹50 per day.
Short 7-Month Contribution Window: Instalments are required for the first 7 months (210 days) only.
Structured 9-Month Cycle: Final maturity payout evaluated at the end of 9 months.
Ideal for budget-conscious savers looking to build systematic discipline.
p4.disclaimer: Illustrative figure shown in the plan brochure. Instalments payable for first 7 months only. Please refer to applicable plan terms for complete details.

p5.title: TERM DEPOSIT PLAN
p5.desc: Choose a structured investment period with options for 1, 2 and 3 years.
p5.overview: Structured monthly investment options across 1, 2, and 3-year tenures for planned medium to long-term wealth building.
features: Monthly investment starting from ₹5,000/month.
Three defined time horizons: 1 Year, 2 Years, and 3 Years.
Direct Commission: Up to 5% referral commission on each monthly instalment.
Maturity Rewards: Company provides gifts along with returns upon maturity.
Taxable Registered Firm: Applicable GST deducted at payout as per rules.
Premature Withdrawal Terms: 5% penalty charge deducted on deposited amount if policy is discontinued early.
p5.disclaimer: As shown in the plan brochure. In case of premature discontinuation, a 5% penalty charge is deducted on deposited funds. Please refer to applicable plan terms for complete details.

p6.title: POCKET-FRIENDLY PLAN
p6.desc: Start your investment journey with a small daily contribution.
p6.overview: An affordable micro-saving plan allowing individuals to turn daily pocket money into a structured multi-phase payout.
features: Pocket-money entry point starting at ₹10 per day.
450 Days (15 Months) deposit window accumulating ₹4,500 total deposit.
Monthly Withdrawal Payouts: ₹160/month paid for 25 consecutive months (Months 16 to 40 = ₹4,000).
Maturity Benefit: ₹5,100 lump-sum paid at the end of the 40th month.
Total Stated Payout: ₹9,100 total return shown in brochure timetable.
Dual Commission: 5% Direct Commission on instalments + 2% Indirect Commission on next 3 new registrations.

knowledge.faq1Q: How are binary point volumes (PV) calculated?
knowledge.faq1A: Every direct or indirect purchase within your downline carries a point volume value. Purchases made on your Left placement leg contribute to your Left Leg Volume, while purchases on the Right placement leg contribute to your Right Leg Volume.
knowledge.faq2A: Direct referral commissions are credited to your Available Wallet Balance instantly. Binary leg matching commissions are calculated weekly on Sunday at 23:59 EST and processed on the following Tuesday.
knowledge.faq3Q: What happens if a direct referral goes inactive?
knowledge.faq3A: An inactive member does not contribute point volume (PV) for active matching rewards, and their direct sponsor bonus is suspended until they make a qualifying maintenance order of at least 50 PV.
knowledge.faq4Q: How do I request rank promotion certificates?
knowledge.faq4A: Once the system automatically promotes your account status (e.g. Diamond Director), you can head to the Support desk to submit a direct ticket request to corporate admin.
